title: Varna 1444: The Broken Oath Raised on a Lance
summary: Tells how Murad the Second signed the Peace of Edirne–Szeged in fourteen forty-four and left the throne to his twelve-year-old son Mehmed the Second, then came back from retirement when the oath was broken and the Crusade of Varna began. The episode covers the twentieth-year-old King Władysław the Third's charge at the Janissaries at Varna on the tenth of November, fourteen forty-four, and the loss of his head, John Hunyadi's escape, and what this victory meant for the Balkans and for Constantinople.
